title: Silver Springs Clear Kayak Tour – Manatees & Monkeys Tour
includes: Optional Upgrade: High-End Wood Paddle Boards
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Paddle over crystal-clear spring water where you can see manatees swimming directly beneath you—and even spot wild monkeys along the shoreline. This is the only place in the U.S. where you can experience both in one unforgettable tour.

Enjoy a small-group, beginner-friendly experience as your guide leads you through the most wildlife-rich areas of Silver Springs. Most guests have never kayaked or paddle boarded—we start with a quick, easy lesson so you feel confident before heading out.

Along the way, you may see manatees, monkeys, turtles, birds, and more while learning about the history and ecosystem of this world-famous spring.

As a family-run company with over 15 years of experience, we’re known for delivering fun, safe, and memorable tours. Choose from premium clear kayaks or high-end paddleboards for the best possible view of the water.

Featured on the Travel Channel and trusted by thousands of guests across Florida. Tours fill quickly—book now to reserve your spot.
